Causeway Capital Management is hiring a Software Engineer Intern to support the technology infrastructure used by its quantitative and fundamental investment groups. The intern will help design, implement, and maintain APIs, Python libraries, backend databases, applications, data pipelines, and cloud-based infrastructure for investment research and data processing.

Collaborate with fellow engineers to build, analyze, and improve Causeway’s proprietary investment management applications and research platforms
Execute project assignments, which may require the Software Engineer – Intern to:
Develop Python applications and AI tools that enhance the productivity of Quantitative Analysts
Build data pipelines using best-of-bread open-source tools
Conduct data analysis using SQL and Python
Delivery of quality code and data
